blocks.text: Blockchain system kuch aham hisson (components) se mil kar banta hai:

items: Node: node woh computer hai jo blockchain network mein shamil hota hai. Har node blockchain ki copy rakhta hai aur transactions aur blocks ki jaanch (validate) mein madad karta hai.

Ledger: ledger blockchain par hone wali tamam transactions ka digital record (hisaab ka register) hai. Yeh tamam nodes mein phaila (distributed) hota hai, taake network mein har ek ke paas wahi maloomat ho.
Block: block transactions ka ek majmua (bundle) hai. Har block mein ek munfarid pehchan (hash), pichhle block ka hawala (parent hash) aur transactions ki list hoti hai.
Transaction: transaction blockchain ka ek alag andraj (entry) hai. Yeh network ke shurakaa (participants) ke darmiyan kisi asset (qeemti cheez) ya maloomat ki muntaqili (transfer) dikhata hai.

Blockchain Protocol: protocol woh qawaid aur tareeqe tay karta hai ke transactions ki jaanch kaise hogi, blocks chain mein kaise jurenge, aur consensus (ittefaq) kaise hoga. Yeh network ki durustagi (integrity) aur hifazat yaqeeni banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Distributed ledger ki banawat samjhaiye aur bataiye ke ise decentralized kyun rakha jata hai (exercise long question 1).
blocks.explanation: Banawat: ledger blocks ki zanjeer hai; har block mein transactions, apna hash aur pichhle block ka hash (parent hash) hota hai, is liye blocks tarteeb se jure rehte hain. Network ka har node poori copy rakhta hai aur protocol ke qawaid aur consensus se naye blocks jaanchta hai. Decentralization ki wajah: kisi ek markazi idare par bharosa nahi karna parta; ek jagah kharabi se nizam nahi rukta; chhed chhaar foran pakri jati hai kyunke baqi copies se mel nahi khati; aur sab shurakaa ek hi shaffaf record dekh sakte hain.

items: Components: node, ledger, block (hash + parent hash + transactions), transaction, protocol.
Parent hash blocks ko zanjeer mein jorta hai.
